==Russian==
{{wp|ru:}}

===Etymology===
{{unc|ru|Of unclear origin}}.
* Presumed by [[w:J. J. Mikkola|J. J. Mikkola]] to be borrowed from {{der|ru|non|jarðhús||underground room}}.<ref>{{cite-book
|author=Mikkola, Dr. Joos J.
|authorlink=J. J. Mikkola
|title=Berührungen zwischen den westfinnischen und slavischen Sprachen. I. Slavische Lehnwörter in den westfinnischen Sprachen
|url=http://urn.fi/URN:NBN:fi-fe2016083123317
|location=Helsinki
|publisher=[[w:Finno-Ugrian Society|Finno-Ugrian Society]]
|year=1894
|page=20
|pageurl=https://books.google.co.uk/books?id=EOUUAAAAYAAJ&pg=PA20#v=onepage&q&f=false
}}</ref><ref>{{R:sla:Berneker|vol=I|page=446}}</ref> Compare {{m|non|jǫrð||earth, modern Icelandic [[jörð]]}} and {{m|non|hús||house}}. This derivation has however been doubted on phonetic<ref>{{R:ru:Vasmer|ярус}}</ref> and semantic<ref>{{cite-journal|last=Kalima|first=Jalo|title=Zu der Etymologie der russischen Wörter ‘Jarus Und Jabeda.’|url=http://www.jstor.org/stable/43341467|journal=Neuphilologische Mitteilungen|publisher=Modern Language Society of Helsinki|year=1948|volume=49|issue=2|page=56}}</ref> grounds.
* Per Chernykh from {{der|ru|trk}}, related to {{m|ru|яр}}.
* Per Shaposhnikov possibly related to {{m|grc|τριήρης}} (suggesting semantic origin as a row of oars on a rowing vessel).

===Pronunciation===
* {{ru-IPA|я́рус}}
* {{audio|ru|LL-Q7737 (rus)-Rominf-ярус.wav}}

===Noun===
